description: PUT /v8/artifacts/{hash} takes the artifact bytes as an application/octet-stream body. The shared OpenAPI converter models application/json request bodies only, so the operation would otherwise go out with no body at all — every upload would store an empty artifact. Adds the whole-body member plus the media type the protocol sends it under.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The artifact bytes, sent verbatim as application/octet-stream.
